# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

completion:
Open test history and create a detailed record explaining why the test was not completed.
3. Start with the date of the test and click on save before moving to the next step.
4. Leave the next day open and specify a temporary pass for the meantime.
5. Return to add a test record for each failed item.
6. Go to the first item and add detailed descriptions explaining why it did not pass the test.
7. Label the user who failed the test.
8. If the user did not specify a reason for the failure, record what you know while running through the failed safety checks to fill in the rest of the description.
9. Enter the label for the failed item category in Elogbooks.
10. Once the entry is saved, move to the next day and include a temporary pass until the next date.
11. Go back to each record and click on the calendar to update
